2. Read the text below:

"Exploring volcanoes is risky business. That's why Carolyn Parcheta and her co-advisor, JPL robotics researcher Aaron Parness, are developing robots that can get into crevices where humans wouldn't be able to go, gaining new insights about these wondrous geological features. (...) The research has implications for extraterrestrial volcanoes. On both Earth and Mars, fissures are the most common physical features from which magma erupts. This is probably also true for the previously active volcanoes on the moon, Mercury, Enceladus and Europa, although the mechanism of volcanic eruption -- whether past or present -- on these other planetary bodies is unknown, Parcheta said. (...) Parcheta, Parness, and JPL co-advisor Karl Mitchell first explored this idea last year using a two-wheeled robot they call Volcanot Bot 1, with a length of 12 inches (30 centimeters) and 6.7 meters (1.5 meters). Their experiments in May 2017, they called Volcanot Bot 1 down a fissure -- a rock that contains magma -- was now inactive on the active Volcanot Bot in Hawaii. Finding preserved and accessible fissures is rare. Volcanot Bot 1 was tasked with mapping the pathways of magma from May 5 to 9, 2014. It was able to descend to depths of 82 feet (25 meters) in two locations on the fissure, although it could have gone deeper with a longer tether, as the bottom was not reached on either descent."

Com base nos textos aparecido é possivel affirmar:
a. () Não existem quaisquer aplicações理論 que demarcem a comprehensão de emoções humanas por robos. Dessa forma, a interação entre homem e最关键的 deve ser a maior objetiva possivel.

b. ( ) Robos sociaveis são desenvivos para intergir com pessoas, comprehenderando as emoções do.), para meir da identificacao deexpressos faciais. Essa Tecnologia ja está muito bem fundamental e não há Utility de desenvolvimento para outras aplicacoes especialicas.

c. ( ) Sentimentos e emocções são caracterizações complexas,EPROMAs de seres humanos. Embora a implementação de emocções em robos selea a Tecnologia superdada, a identificacao dessas caractéctricas pelos robos podeTRAzer invenções à interação entre o homem e a equipe.

d. () A comprenso do sentimientos humanos pelos robos é importante para ampliar aplicações que envolvem a interação entre o homem e a equipe. No entanto, seria irrelevantamente implementar emocções em robos com aplicações especialicas, que independem por natureza, do humor do usoário.
